question: Response field names carrying 'type' and frontend coupling to the error code (Q6)
claim: 1) Resources response records (all internal records): GetResourceTypeQueryResult and GetResourceTypesQueryResult each = Id Guid, GroupId Guid, Name string, Description string?, CreatedAt DateTime, PropertyDefinitions IReadOnlyList<PropertyDefinitionResult>; neither has a property named *Type*. PropertyDefinitionResult = Id Guid, Name string, DataType string, IsRequired bool (DataType = property data kind). GetResourceInstanceQueryResult and ResourceInstanceRowDto = Id Guid, ResourceTypeId Guid, GroupId Guid, Name string, Description string?, OwnerId Guid, CreatedAt DateTime, DeletedAt DateTime?, PropertyValues IReadOnlyList<PropertyValueResult>; ResourceTypeId = the resource type/schema reference. PropertyValueResult = PropertyDefinitionId Guid, PropertyName string, DataType string (data kind), Value string. Instance-list wrapper GetResourceInstancesQueryResult = Items IReadOnlyList<ResourceInstanceRowDto>, NextCursor Guid?. There is no TypeId or TypeName property in these records. 2) POST /resources/types returns Results.Created($"/resources/types/{createdId}", new { id = createdId }); POST /resources/instances returns Results.Created($"/resources/instances/{createdId}", new { id = createdId }). Location templates: /resources/types/{id} and /resources/instances/{id}. 3) Requests: CreateResourceTypeRequest(Guid GroupId, string Name, string? Description, IEnumerable<PropertyDefinitionInputDto>? PropertyDefinitions); PropertyDefinitionInputDto(string Name, PropertyDataType DataType, bool IsRequired). UpdateResourceTypeRequest(string Name, string? Description, IEnumerable<PropertyDefinitionUpdateInputDto>? PropertyDefinitions); PropertyDefinitionUpdateInputDto(Guid? Id, string Name, PropertyDataType DataType, bool IsRequired). CreateResourceInstanceRequest(Guid ResourceTypeId, string Name, string? Description, IEnumerable<PropertyValueInputDto>? PropertyValues); PropertyValueInputDto(Guid PropertyDefinitionId, string Value). UpdateResourceInstanceRequest(string Name, string? Description, IEnumerable<UpdatePropertyValueDto>? PropertyValues); UpdatePropertyValueDto(Guid PropertyDefinitionId, string Value). Properties with 'Type' in name: ResourceTypeId (create instance; resource type reference), DataType (property data kind, PropertyDataType enum). 4) Frontend: no occurrence of RESOURCE_TYPE_NAME_TAKEN or NAME_TAKEN in frontend/src (case-insensitive grep). The only reads of API error code/message are: auth.mapper.ts:15,18 (body.errors[0].code / .message, auth feature, not Resources) and error.interceptor.ts:30 (resolveMessage reads body.message ?? body.title ?? statusText, shows a toast via notifications.error for status>=400 unless x-silent-errors header; no .code read). Resources call sites (create-resource-modal.component.ts:131-132, schema-designer-page.component.ts:207-208, group-detail-page.component.ts:188) catch and rely on the interceptor toast with no code inspection. Schema name errors in schema-designer-page.component.ts:248,252 are client-side validation messages ('Schema name is required.', '...100 characters or fewer.'), not API-derived. 5) DTOs in resources-api.service.ts: PropertyDefinitionDto{id string, name string, dataType 'Text'|'Number'|'Boolean', isRequired boolean}; ResourceTypeSummaryDto{id, groupId, name: string, description string|null, createdAt string, propertyDefinitions PropertyDefinitionDto[]}; ResourceTypeDetailDto = alias of ResourceTypeSummaryDto; CreateResourceInstancePayload{resourceTypeId string, name string, description string|null, propertyValues {propertyDefinitionId string; value string|null}[]}. There is no ResourceRowDto; instance list uses ResourceInstancesPageDto = generated ThingsBooksy...GetResourceInstancesQueryResult from data-contracts. Fields mirroring backend 'type' names: resourceTypeId (CreateResourceInstancePayload and the generated CreateResourceInstanceRequest), dataType. 6) No file under frontend/src imports from src/app/api/Resources.ts (grep for 'api/Resources' found no import). The only import from the api folder in resources-api.service.ts is types from '../../../api/data-contracts' (lines 4-9). Importers of resources-api.service.ts (the hand-written service): schema-designer-page.component.ts:15, group-context.store.ts:13, create-resource-modal.component.ts:25, group-detail-page.component.ts:24. Not exhaustively searched for other generated-client importers beyond the 'api/Resources' pattern.
